newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Cholera kills 10 in southern Nigeria. [CORRECTED 18:53 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Cholera kills 10 in southern Nigeria. [CORRECTED 18:53 GMT]

text.p: An outbreak of cholera has killed 10 people and grounded 200 others in Akoko-Edo area of southern Nigeria, the state news agency reported on Monday.
The chairman of the Akoko-Edo local council, Babatunde Agbogun said the outbreak followed disconnection of power to the Ojirami dam, the only source of pure water supply in the area.
Epidemics of cholera are common in rural areas of Nigeria where pipe-borne water is not always available.
